vision_judge_audit.notes_zh: Gemini 3.8 Flash 結構化視覺審核拒絕：HANDLE_REGENERATION_OR_TILT

shannon_diagnostic_ranking.name_zh: 側面 90° 切線橫柄被重生、分叉或外端蓋長出新桿
shannon_diagnostic_ranking.diagnostic_check: 檢查握柄是否維持柱身側面中段單一 90° 直桿且外端蓋 C_outer 100% 空置
shannon_diagnostic_ranking.repair_action: Preserve existing single straight 90-degree side-middle rod handle; keep outer circular cap 100% bare.

shannon_diagnostic_ranking.name_zh: 凍結遮罩區域（背景錨點、外端蓋、非編輯區）發生未授權像素漂移
shannon_diagnostic_ranking.diagnostic_check: 檢查 freeze_mask 區域之合成後像素漂移是否為 0
shannon_diagnostic_ranking.repair_action: Composite with parent raster using freeze_mask so all non-editable pixels remain 100% locked.

shannon_diagnostic_ranking.name_zh: 柱底貼合座與接觸點 P 脫離或無發光
shannon_diagnostic_ranking.diagnostic_check: 檢查泡殼側弧形底座是否 100% 貼合泡殼曲率並鎖定於接觸點 P 發光
shannon_diagnostic_ranking.repair_action: Lock conformal circular base seat flush at contact point P with cyan-white collar glow.

shannon_diagnostic_ranking.name_zh: 可編輯遮罩區域無實質變化（No-Op 子幀）
shannon_diagnostic_ranking.diagnostic_check: 檢查 edit_mask 區域之平均亮度變化 (edit_region_mae_luma) 是否高於最小門檻
shannon_diagnostic_ranking.repair_action: Ensure the stage's authorized physical action produces a measurable change inside edit_mask.

shannon_diagnostic_ranking.name_zh: 人物未握住既有握柄或為配合手部位置重新生成新桿
shannon_diagnostic_ranking.diagnostic_check: 檢查 D2/D3 手臂是否只移動去握住原圖已存在的那條橫柄
shannon_diagnostic_ranking.repair_action: Move ONLY the warrior's forearms/hands to wrap around the existing straight rod handle; forbid new shafts.

shannon_diagnostic_ranking.name_zh: E_MID / E_END 裂紋未從同一接觸點 P 向外擴散
shannon_diagnostic_ranking.diagnostic_check: 檢查放射狀裂紋與碎片是否嚴格以接觸點 P 為唯一震央向外擴散
shannon_diagnostic_ranking.repair_action: Anchor all radial spiderweb cracks and outward shell shards strictly at contact point P.

shannon_diagnostic_ranking.name_zh: 泡殼內部聖城建築或居民受損
shannon_diagnostic_ranking.diagnostic_check: 檢查內部暖金梯田聖城與居民是否保持完好無損（只破外殼）
shannon_diagnostic_ranking.repair_action: Freeze interior warm-golden miniature terraced sanctuary city and inhabitants 100% intact.

repair_prompt_patch: SHANNON DIAGNOSTIC REPAIR (Gain=1.0 bits): Preserve existing single straight 90-degree side-middle rod handle; keep outer circular cap 100% bare. [Check: 檢查握柄是否維持柱身側面中段單一 90° 直桿且外端蓋 C_outer 100% 空置]
